source: OneTrust consent states, as the banner script reports them. OnetrustActiveGroups is the comma-delimited string with leading and trailing commas that OneTrust sets on the window; the harness assigns it and then fires the signal OneTrust would.

fixtures.name: banner not yet answered
fixtures.description: No active groups. RUM must stay held.

fixtures.name: strictly necessary only
fixtures.description: The visitor rejected everything optional. Analytics stays not-granted.

fixtures.name: performance accepted
fixtures.description: C0002 is active, so RUM may collect.

fixtures.name: consent withdrawn
fixtures.description: The visitor returns to the preference centre and turns performance off again.
